messages.subject: n_eff low
parts:
I have seen some models where n_eff was very low but the Rhat was 1.00. Also the densities looked fine.
Can there be situations where n_eff can be misleading?

Dirk

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] n_eff low
parts:
There are situations where n_eff can be severely overestimated,
but it really can’t be underestimated.  If n_eff / iteration is less
than 0.001 then I would not trust the output of the fit regardless
of Rhat and simple visual diagnostics.
